title: Boots of Striding

sources.title: Focused Stride
markers: | description = When you cast a spell that requires {{Concentration}}, you gain {{Cond|Momentum}} for 1 turn. While you are concentrating, you cannot be knocked {{Cond|Prone}} or moved against your will.

summary: +1 Athletics. Casting a concentration spell grants 1 turn of Momentum. While concentrating you cannot be knocked Prone or moved against your will. Equipping these boots while already concentrating may fail to apply that protection. Momentum increases speed by 5 ft per turn remaining, up to 5 turns.
